samples.title: Dispatch order: Proof strip
samples.statement:
A dispatch board permits a job only after every incoming dependency has been removed. Tomas rolls a fresh proof strip into the office typewriter. The supervisor wants the readings in their precise working order before signing the file.

links is a square 0/1 directed adjacency matrix. Queue all zero-indegree vertices in increasing order; pop FIFO, visit neighbors in increasing order, and enqueue a neighbor when its indegree becomes zero. Produce this vertex order, or no values if a cycle prevents a complete order.

Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.

Implement dispatchOrderProofStrip(links, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Dispatch order: Floor ticket
samples.statement:
A dispatch board permits a job only after every incoming dependency has been removed. Ivo is checking the lower stop before the ribbon press opens. A negative reading is a real measurement and must not be replaced by an invented zero.

links is a square 0/1 directed adjacency matrix. Queue all zero-indegree vertices in increasing order; pop FIFO, visit neighbors in increasing order, and enqueue a neighbor when its indegree becomes zero. Produce this vertex order, or no values if a cycle prevents a complete order.

Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement dispatchOrderFloorTicket(links, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Dispatch order: Boss receipt
samples.statement:
A dispatch board permits a job only after every incoming dependency has been removed. Pia adds numbered weights to the final receipt at the unit's inspection desk. The first derived reading has weight one, so its position matters as much as its value.

links is a square 0/1 directed adjacency matrix. Queue all zero-indegree vertices in increasing order; pop FIFO, visit neighbors in increasing order, and enqueue a neighbor when its indegree becomes zero. Produce this vertex order, or no values if a cycle prevents a complete order.

Return the weighted sum of the derived sequence: multiply its first value by 1, its second by 2, and so on, then add the products. Return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement dispatchOrderBossReceipt(links, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
